verdicts.reason: app/payments.py:7 makes a blocking requests.post to an external payments API with no timeout= argument, exactly the pattern that was fixed in shipping.py. There is no session-level timeout, no wrapper, and no guard elsewhere: the call goes straight from the module-level PAYMENTS_URL through requests.post and the response is used immediately (raise_for_status + .json()). If pay.example.com stalls, the calling thread blocks indefinitely. The identical fix applies: add timeout=10 (or similar) to the requests.post call.
